title: Frame for relocated preparation
statement: Let $H$ be a type, let $k,l$ be positive natural numbers, let $e:\mathrm{Fin}(9)\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$ be a function, let $w,s,u,v$ be Boolean words, let $q\in\mathrm{Fin}(9)$, and let $o$ be a Boolean flag. Embed the preparation configuration on input $w$, with words $s,u,v$ on its three tapes, phase $q$, flag $o$, input head at position $1$, and all work heads at zero, into the host using the administrative triple of tape positions; fill the other host tapes with blanks and rename the state by $e$. The result is exactly the configuration on input $w$ with state $e(q,o)$, the full host word layout consisting of candidate $s$, width word $u$, and suffix-length word $v$, input head at position $1$, all work heads at zero, and empty output.
replaced:
At zero head displacements, relocating a preparation frame through the
administrative-triple selection coincides exactly with the host's canonical
configuration on the complete word layout, not merely with its two argument
projections.
